scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.description: A gateway just started: no calls, no sessions, no provider.

scenarios.name: busy
scenarios.description: The page's development fixture: 40 calls, 3 in flight, limits, a provider with 3 pods.

scenarios.name: token-flow
scenarios.description: 8 states: calls with tokens appear for 3 sessions over 3 routes; sessions start, one ends.

scenarios.name: errors
scenarios.description: Refusals, 429s with retries, a stale watchdog, a pod shutting down within a minute.

scenarios.name: offline
scenarios.description: Two states of traffic, then the stream errors and the snapshot poll fails.
